drafted_from: tools/workflows/tool-rows.json row, do-work/measure-citation-coverage.mjs, read-data/citation-coverage.mjs and test/citation-coverage.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run tool:measure-page-citation-coverage for https://example.com/a on engine-one and engine-two with these recorded answers, and tell me which cells cited the page." It builds the full page by question by engine grid and counts only exact page citations.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the plan and the recorded answers handed in the call and answers the counts and cells straight back.
instructions: 1. Write your plan: each page url (add canonical_url and verified_redirects only if you checked them), the questions, and the answer engines.

2. Write one observation per cell you already asked: page_url, question, engine, status (observed, unavailable or not-run), and for observed ones the answer and a citations array. Leave unasked cells out.
3. Say "Run tool:measure-page-citation-coverage" with that plan and those observations; the AI sends it with tools:run at @workshop-tools.

4. Read what comes back: cited and not_cited count only observed answers, unknown counts unavailable and unasked cells, citation_rate is cited over measured (null when nothing was measured), and cells lists every cell with its citation as true, false or null.
5. Ask the missing engines again for the cells marked not-run or unavailable, add those observations, and run it again.

worked_examples.title: One page, two questions, two engines: one cited, one not, two unknown
worked_examples.ask: Run tool:measure-page-citation-coverage for https://example.com/a on engine-one and engine-two with these recorded answers.
worked_examples.given: From tools/workflows/test/citation-coverage.test.mjs: the page https://example.com/a has canonical https://example.com/articles/a and a verified redirect from https://old.example.com/a. engine-one cited https://example.com/articles/a#details for "What is A?"; engine-two cited only https://example.com/another-page; engine-one was unavailable (Sign-in required) for "How does A work?"; engine-two was never asked that.
worked_examples.hands_back: planned {pages 1, questions 2, engines 2, cells 4}, measured 2, cited 1, not_cited 1, unknown 2, citation_rate 0.5. Cells in order: (What is A?, engine-one) status observed, citation true, citations [https://example.com/articles/a#details]; (What is A?, engine-two) observed, citation false; (How does A work?, engine-one) unavailable, citation null, reason "Sign-in required"; (How does A work?, engine-two) not-run, citation null. Each cell_id is the JSON array [page_url, question, engine].
